title: purchase.prepayment_paid payload
description: A profile P prepayment was paid, Dreamshop -> kaikei. Gives kaikei the payment date, on which the prepayment's VAT is reposted (A9). obligation_id is the prepayment's, and with the event type it is the idempotency key.

client_id.description: The kaikei client (one kaikei deployment = one client = one e-conomic agreement). Carried in data because the envelope has additionalProperties:false. The receiver rejects a foreign client with klient_forkert.
